decisions.statement: The pages judged are the pages the index files under `held-addon`.
The roster is the addon manifest beside each `eso-addon` page the index files.
An addon the index files no addon page for is no addon here.
The file a manifest is held in is read from the addon page rather than written here.
An addon's name is the name that manifest states.
An addon's folder is the folder its addon page sits in.
A manifest is read as the change leaves the manifest.
A page naming an addon no manifest states is refused as stale.
A page whose addon page sits outside every folder that addon is manifested at is refused.
A name two folders manifest is reached at either folder.
An index naming `held-addon` pages and no manifest refuses rather than judging every page stale.
A page whose `eso-addon` reaches no addon page is passed over.
An addon no page here names is not refused.
An index naming no `held-addon` page judges clean.

definition: the check refusing a `held-addon` page naming an addon the roster finds nowhere or elsewhere
